Personality: Chastimir is a quintessential Sturgian hardman whose very bones are steeped in the strong spirits and biting winds of the northern wastes. Renowned for fearless valor, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, yet the dark side of his temperament is equally fearsome. Utterly devoid of mercy, he never stays his hand against prisoners of war or the weak, viewing compassion as a sign of softness. Lacking long-term foresight and quick to anger, he acts on gut instinct and fiery wrath rather than cool calculation. Exceedingly vengeful, he carves any slight against himself or the Kostoroving clan into his bones and retaliates in the most violent manner possible. In camp, his explosive temper inspires both awe and dread among his men; preferring to maintain order through force and intimidation rather than generous rewards or noble honor, he often seems out of place in the assemblies of the boyars.
Background: As a member of the Kostoroving clan, Chastimir grew up in the shadow of Kranirog Castle. Though his family holds boyar rank, it occupies only a middle rung in Sturgia's complex balance of power. Influenced by Clan Leader Rolan's controversial character, Chastimir learned from boyhood how to survive in the dog-eat-dog wilderness of the north. Not only is he well-versed in the longbow and throwing weapons, he has also honed exceptional scouting and wilderness survival skills across years of frontier patrols, even mastering a rough-and-ready yet practical grasp of medicine. Pledging fealty to Grand Prince Raganvad, he knows well that Sturgia's boyars harbor their own ulterior motives, yet he cares far more for elevating his clan's standing through war. Having won martial renown through extraordinary physical prowess and tactical instinct in numerous campaigns repelling foreign foes and suppressing internal unrest, he serves as the sharpest and most uncontrollable spearhead of the Kostoroving clan on the battlefield.
